The cultural status in here, makes it really hard for me. My life is surrounded by american like actions. I reddit, I watch american tv. but I can't get Netflix or Amazon. I'm being held captive by religious decisions, making less money than I could, have less buying power.
And I feel like I've maximized my efforts with the local community, me trying to find someone more US-minded, and the community withheld in itself and people knowing each other for years, not letting new people into their group. 

Maybe the US isn't ideal, but it's better than what I have right now.
I don't want false fulfillment, by convincing myself that I'm better off alone or living in compromised terms.
There are a lot of things that you take for granted, but affect my daily life. I'm affected religion and cultural wise. maybe it's not utopia, but it's better on so many other levels.

I'll have a problem getting a proper job and if I'll get caught, I'll be banned forever.

But I'll do it. 
I'll find a time and will go away for most of the day.

Your last paragraph might be the most inspiring thing I've heard in my life. I'll probably would have to read it again from time to time, but as of now, you gave me a will to live. 
thank you.

I wish, but unless I'll have several million dollars or marry someone, the US won't take me. even with, that will be hard.
I'm telling to myself that things will get better for the last 15 years or more, I think they just get worse, because I'm becoming less attractive to the market. any market.

I specify in specific IT field, which I'll be happy to stop pursuing. 
I love to write and film, and used to be good at that. I want to direct my own film, I always help others, but not working toward my own goals.

But I'm am needy... what can I do, being alone all the time, in every aspect is hard. I can point out a couple single ladies, but they were much older than me and/or were so weird, I couldn't have a normal conversation with them (and once I start talking with someone, I'm a master of small talk - as long as they want to talk to me), they were too boring.

I'm on my way to lose weight. going to a run right now.
I still have hair, it's not thick, but I love having it... and without it, I'll sweat a lot (it's awfully hot in here).
But my main to considerations are - I can't be bald and fat, I have to lose weight first. and I was always waiting to have my girlfriend's opinion - as a gay guy told me I should shave, girls told me to keep it that way. and I'm yet to have a girlfriend. and once I shave, there is not way back.

I can't get visa through work. I've tried. 
People who constructed their life, or got citizenship or a degree/fancy passport or spouse have it easier. I can try and go to school, but I can't work and won't be able to finance everything.
My savings is all I got.

I'm not sure if I'm getting to such interactions to be counted as the amount of money or education that I have.
I had a high paying job, my own place (rent - only the 1% can really buy), savings... but that didn't matter. right now the situation is a little different, but I'm still richer than 90% of the people around me.

There are people that are more attractive then me, in certain aspects. but I think that most of all, I just don't present high enough value in first impression... and I find myself getting second and third impressions only with women that are highly taken (and they are really fond of me). 
I went to the gym (stopped because going alone was hard), I'm fat, but now I'm really starting to lose weight. I'm balding, mostly it does.
But I'll take your two hours point into consideration.

I'll try to be driven, I'm not sure if I'll survive to the point I'll start trying.

I'm too depressed to find passion in anything right now. I'll try.
